Sandbox_KnoxAquarium_FreeTanks_tooltip: Who can place an aquarium from the right-click menu without an Empty Aquarium item. The server checks this on every placement. Tanks from found or packed Empty Aquarium items can always be placed.
Sandbox_KnoxAquarium_ComfortEnabled_tool: A stocked, watered tank slightly lowers unhappiness, boredom and stress for players standing near it. Untick to turn this off entirely; placing, stocking and viewing tanks is unaffected.
Sandbox_KnoxAquarium_ComfortRange_toolti: How close a player must be to a stocked tank to get the stress relief, in tiles (roughly the same room).
Sandbox_KnoxAquarium_ComfortMaxTanks_too: How many nearby tanks can contribute before the benefit stops increasing, so a room lined with aquariums is not a bigger bonus than a couple of tanks.
Sandbox_KnoxAquarium_FishSurviveMinMinut: How many real-world minutes a freshly caught fish survives out of water at 0 Fishing skill, before it must reach a tank.
Sandbox_KnoxAquarium_FishSurviveMaxMinut: How many real-world minutes a freshly caught fish survives out of water at 10 Fishing skill, before it must reach a tank.
